Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited reported strong operational and financial performance for Q1 FY27, driven by healthy volume expansion and new capacity coming online, including the Marol manufacturing facility. Management highlighted constructive demand for organized jewellery and reaffirmed top-line growth guidance of 50% to 60% in value and 30% to 40% in volume for the year. To support this ongoing growth trajectory and working capital requirements, the company approved a rights issue of up to INR100 crores and is progressing with the upcoming Jaipur facility. Furthermore, management expects sustainable EBITDA margins to normalize around 7.5% to 8% going forward after factoring out inventory-related unrealized gains realized during the quarter. Shanti Gold International Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting revenue from operations of Rs 716.4 Cr and a PAT of Rs 50.5 Cr.

guidance.claim: Management sticks to the top-line guidance of 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth for the year.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

guidance.claim: Management expects sustainable EBITDA margins to be around 7.5% to 8% this year.
guidance.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

guidance.claim: Management expects approximately 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the upcoming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management stated that the sustainable net profit margin (PAT) is around 4% plus.
guidance.quote: This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all.

guidance.claim: Management expects export share to increase from 10% to 20% or maybe more.
guidance.quote: So I told you like this year will be like from 5% to we are going to go up to 10% or maybe more. Sorry, from 10% to 20%.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for organized jewellery continues to remain constructive, supported by wedding and occasion-led demand.
demand_outlook.quote: From an industry perspective, the outlook for the organized jewellery continues to remain constructive. India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Approximately 75% of sales consist of cast-studded jewellery.
Growing disposable income drives gold as a status symbol and investment.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing disposable income drives gold as status symbol & investment

demand_outlook.claim: Seasonal demand arises from weddings, Diwali, and harvest festivals.
demand_outlook.quote: Seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali & harvest festivals

demand_outlook.claim: Despite elevated gold prices, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness healthy transactions particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Organized jewellers and retailers continue to show an increasing outsourcing preference to expand footprints and optimize inventory.
demand_outlook.quote: One of the most encouraging trends we are witnessing today is the increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers, retailers, as retailers continue to focus on expanding their footprint, inventory optimizing, and faster design cycles.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations successfully commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen the company's manufacturing footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, the upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen our manufacturing footprint and support our ability to address the growing demand across markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The allocated capex for the Jaipur facility is around INR47 crores, and it is expected to be operational around November, mid-November, or December.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during the IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming capacity additions will take total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The Marol factory is expected to start in a month or so, while the Jaipur factory is expected to start around September or October.
capex_expansion.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q1 FY27 stood at INR50.48 crores with a PAT margin of 7.05%.
margins_costs.quote: The profit after tax stood at INR50.48 crores compared to INR34.36 crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Roughly 2% to 2.5% of the quarter's EBITDA margin comprised unrealized inventory gains locked in finished goods from the previous year due to a change in the inventory method from FIFO to WAC.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 gross profit was Rs 78.0 Cr with a gross margin of 10.9%.
Q1 FY27 EBITDA was Rs 71.5 Cr with an EBITDA margin of 10.0%.
Q1 FY27 PAT was Rs 50.5 Cr with a PAT margin of 7.1%.
EBITDA margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 10.17% compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17% as compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for FY26 stood at 6.94% compared to 4.89% in FY25, improving by 205 basis points Y-o-Y.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for FY26 stood at 6.94% as compared to 4.89% in FY25, improving by 205 basis pointsY-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: The core operational business PAT margin is around 3.5% to 4%.
margins_costs.quote: core margin is around 3.5% to 4%, that's for sure.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the existing Mumbai facility is currently at 75%.
Installed capacity after commissioning stands at ~6,700 kg per annum for Andheri and Marol combined.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)

orders_capacity.claim: Total capacity on completion will reach 7,900 kg per annum including the Jaipur facility.
The existing Andheri manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current capacity utilization is around 65%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares aggregating up to INR100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The current debt-to-equity ratio stands at 0.50.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: Funds acquired from the rights issue will be invested completely in gold and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: So right now we -- the money what we are acquiring from rights issue is going to be invested completely in gold and working capital.

capital_allocation.claim: The company transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from FIFO to the weighted average cost method with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from the First In, First Out, FIFO method to the weighted average cost WAC method with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a return on capital employed (ROCE) of 38%.
capital_allocation.quote: ROCE and everything is concerned it still is at a very healthy margin of say I think 38%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are based on management's current expectations and are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially.
risks_headwinds.quote: These statements are based on management's current expectations and are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause the actual results to differ materially.

risks_headwinds.claim: Due to geopolitical situations and ongoing wars involving Iran, the incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary has been extended.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.

management_commitments.claim: Management maintains the top-line guidance of 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

management_commitments.claim: The Jaipur facility is scheduled to be operational around November, mid-November, or December.
management_commitments.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets 30% to 40% volume growth and 60% to 70% value growth for the upcoming year.
management_commitments.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the Jaipur factory to start operations around September or October.
management_commitments.quote: I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.
